lines: META heavy-kernel lab at M256 vs LI4 (LI_swap 701d2867: N_full, heavy N32 lean K loop, W13 gate/up rows interleaved by 8 with SwiGLU in registers, grid 2112, launched first on the side stream || NT1<=16; live route; one join; finalizer split over 4 blocks per token, 5e197b5e). LIW: wide packed banks; TYP/TYPW: static typed activation smem (base/wide); WP: four W2 per-warp norm partials summed by finalizer; PAIR2/4: one decode feeds two separate N32 WGMMA accumulators, 2/4 pipeline stages (no N64 WGMMA). Adaptive lab: AD64/128D/P/PW uses only live independent N32 groups, capacity 64/128, S2; D=hoisted descriptor, P=rotated packed scale words, PW=P+wide. PERM/PERMW applies P/PW on N32 S4. 12 seeds x3 fresh routes, lab_cold_l2, AB/BA x6, A:A.
GATE TASK FP32 L2<=.015,row<=.075,finite before+after timing (failures recorded, still timed); bit=equal to LI4 output (diagnostic). Phase means are diagnostics.
